facts.qualification: Runtime property lookup only. No missing method was invoked; original Owl behavior and substitute implementations were not tested.

reconciledDecisions.decision: 普通Electron 42.3.0不能直接执行已登记的Owl能力调用；公开声明中的212条保留为公开接口候选，17条须独立处置。
reconciledDecisions.limitation: No argument, callback, event, platform or behavioral compatibility implied.

reconciledDecisions.decision: 第一方适配按菜单、测量、运行时策略、诊断、窗口、通知授权、鼠标能力、浏览器权限和字体枚举九组能力分界。运行时实现由独立依赖提供，不导出第三方实现。
reconciledDecisions.limitation: Maintenance responsibility proposal; no substitute selected, implemented or proven.

reconciledDecisions.decision: 浏览器will-attach及did-attach的接收身份、重复接收拒绝、generation检查与清理顺序已有BA-04至BA-08静态证据，不再把这部分列为完全未知。
reconciledDecisions.limitation: Native lease consumption, transfer/clone effects and whole lifecycle integration remain unverified.

reconciledDecisions.decision: live-history复制的公开导航原语及当前表单差异复用既有对照；不重复发起同一探针，也不把公开JS堆差异误写为原Owl保证。
独立Owl来源、Node网络/IPC执行、更新原生provider、adoption/clone及特权浏览器设置属于额外边界，17条不是全部私有能力分母。
